class.name: TweensGdInterpolation
class.brief_description: Interpolates supported values and resolves property component paths.
class.description: Used by property definitions and custom adapters. Supported values are int, float, Vector2, Vector3, Vector4, Color, Quaternion, and Rect2. Weight may overshoot [code][0, 1][/code]. C# equivalent: [code]Interpolators[/code] and the property adapters.

method.name: add
method.description: Adds [param offset] to [param value]. Quaternion offsets compose rotations by multiplication.

method.name: compatible
method.description: True if endpoints share a supported type; int and float endpoints may mix.

method.name: finite
method.description: True if [param value] is supported and all its components are finite.

method.name: interpolate
method.description: Interpolates [param from] and [param to] as [param value_type]. Weight may overshoot. Integers round ties away from zero and saturate at 64-bit limits; C# Int uses 32-bit limits. Quaternions use normalized spherical interpolation.

method.name: read_property
method.description: Reads a property or value-component path on [param target]. Paths cannot cross Objects or traverse nodes.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes [param offset] from [param value]. Quaternion offsets use inverse rotation composition.

method.name: supported
method.description: True if [param value] has a supported interpolation type.

method.name: zero
method.description: Returns the additive identity for [param value_type]; Quaternion uses IDENTITY.
